plugin.aes-sbox.title: AES S-box derivation
plugin.aes-sbox.param.byteHint: Exactly one byte as two hex digits, e.g. 53.
plugin.aes-sbox.op.square: Square – double the exponent of the running power
plugin.aes-sbox.op.multiply: Multiply – multiply the running power by x
plugin.aes-sbox.op.inverse: Inverse – x²⁵⁴ is the multiplicative inverse of x
plugin.aes-sbox.op.affineBit: Affine bit – compute one output bit of the affine map
plugin.aes-sbox.op.result: Result – S(x), checked against the S-box table
plugin.aes-sbox.step.load: Input x = {{x}}. S(x) is derived in two phases: first invert x in the finite field GF(2⁸), then apply the affine map.
plugin.aes-sbox.step.loadZero: Input x = {{x}}. Zero is special: it has no multiplicative inverse, so the inversion phase uses a convention.
plugin.aes-sbox.step.inverse: x²⁵⁴ = x⁻¹ = {{inverse}}, because every nonzero x satisfies x²⁵⁵ = {01}. Check: {{x}} • {{inverse}} = {01}.
plugin.aes-sbox.step.inverseZero: {{x}} has no multiplicative inverse. By convention it maps to {{inverse}}, so the affine map receives zero.
plugin.aes-sbox.step.affineBit: Bit {{bit}}: b'{{bit}} = {{terms}} ⊕ c{{bit}} = {{values}} ⊕ {{c}} = {{result}}. Output so far: {{partial}}.
plugin.aes-sbox.step.result: S({{x}}) = {{s}}, the same entry as row {{row}}, column {{col}} of the S-box table.
plugin.aes-sbox.step.resultZero: S({{x}}) = {{s}}: with a zero inverse only the constant c survives the affine map. This matches row {{row}}, column {{col}} of the S-box table.
plugin.aes-sbox.table.title: AES S-box (row = high nibble, column = low nibble)
plugin.aes-sbox.error.invalidParams: Give the input byte as hex text.
plugin.aes-sbox.error.byteLength: The input has {{length}} bytes; it needs exactly 1.
